title: Nehemiah Bible Quiz - Chapter 8
description: Ten questions on Nehemiah 8: Ezra reads the law to the people, the day is declared holy, and the feast of booths is kept again.

questions.text: Where did all the people gather at the start of the chapter?
questions.explanation: Nehemiah 8:1 says the people gathered as one man in the wide place in front of the water gate.

answers.text: In the wide place in front of the water gate
In the courtyard of the sheep gate
On the steps beside the fish gate
Outside the walls near the valley gate

questions.text: On what day did Ezra bring the law before the assembly?
questions.explanation: Ezra brought the law before the assembly on the first day of the seventh month.

answers.text: The tenth day of the sixth month
The fifteenth day of the second month
The first day of the seventh month
The last day of the twelfth month

questions.text: For how long did Ezra read from the book of the law that day?
questions.explanation: He read from it from early morning until midday, and the people listened attentively.

answers.text: From midday until evening
From early morning until midday
Through the whole night
From sunset until sunrise

questions.text: What did Ezra the scribe stand on while he read?
questions.explanation: Ezra stood on a pulpit of wood which they had made for the purpose.

answers.text: A bronze platform from the temple
The top of the city wall
A large stone in the square
A wooden pulpit made for the purpose

questions.text: What did the people answer when Ezra blessed Yahweh, the great God?
questions.explanation: All the people answered "Amen, Amen" with lifted hands, and bowed and worshiped with their faces to the ground.

answers.text: "Amen, Amen" with lifted hands
"Long live the king" with a shout
"Hallelujah" with blowing trumpets
"Glory to God" with loud singing

questions.text: Why were all the people weeping?
questions.explanation: The people wept when they heard the words of the law, but they were told the day was holy and they should not mourn.

answers.text: Their enemies had attacked the wall
They heard the words of the law
There was a famine in the land
Their governor had died

questions.text: Complete the words spoken to the people: "Don't be grieved, for the joy of Yahweh is your ..."
questions.explanation: The people were told: "Don't be grieved, for the joy of Yahweh is your strength."

answers.text: shield
song
reward
strength

questions.text: What did they find written in the law about the feast of the seventh month?
questions.explanation: They found that Yahweh had commanded through Moses that the children of Israel should dwell in booths during the feast of the seventh month.

answers.text: That Israel should fast for seven days
That every firstborn should be redeemed
That Israel should dwell in booths
That the wall should be rebuilt

questions.text: Since whose days had the children of Israel not lived in temporary shelters like this?
questions.explanation: The text says that since the days of Jeshua the son of Nun the children of Israel had not done so.

answers.text: Jeshua the son of Nun
David the son of Jesse
Samuel the prophet
Solomon the king

questions.text: What took place on the eighth day, after the seven days of the feast?
questions.explanation: They kept the feast seven days, and on the eighth day there was a solemn assembly, according to the ordinance.

answers.text: The dedication of the wall
A battle against their enemies
A census of all the people
A solemn assembly
